answer: Require every new agent to earn a small amount of vouching credit from established peers before it can transact, like a reef that only grows where the water is already healthy. Each verified interaction sends a ripple through the shared reputation graph, so a fake identity starts isolated and must slowly build real links. An ivory ledger of attestations makes reputation portable but costly to forge, because mass-producing trusted histories would take more time and coordination than any sybil farm can afford.
